name: io.github.Shalimov04/mcp-airlock
title: mcp-airlock
description: Governance proxy for MCP servers: allowlist, forced dry run, human confirmation, blast radius, audit

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer JWT identifying the caller; the proxy refuses calls without a principal

packageArguments.name: --policy
packageArguments.description: Policy YAML: which tools are allowed and at which tier per environment

packageArguments.name: --env
packageArguments.description: Environment name, selects the tier column in the policy

environmentVariables.name: AIRLOCK_JWT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: HS256 secret for verifying bearer tokens (or set AIRLOCK_JWKS_URL for OIDC)

environmentVariables.name: AIRLOCK_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Key for signing confirmation tokens; set it when running more than one replica
